title: Mass Spec Sample Prep on Custom Slide
author: Opentrons
materials: Input the respective numbers of samples and antibodies, and the respective mount sides for your P20 and P300 pipettes.

steps.title: Prepare slide mounts and tuberacks
steps.instruction: Place up to two custom 3‑grid 3 × 8 slide mounts on the deck (the top row of nine wells on each mount will remain empty). Insert the Opentrons 4 × 6 tuberack (1.5 mL Eppendorf snap‑cap tubes) and the Opentrons 2 × 3 tuberack (50 mL Falcon tubes) into their designated slots.

steps.title: Load reagents into 50 mL tuberack
steps.instruction: In the 2 × 3 50 mL tuberack (slot 1) add detergent wash buffer to tube A1, BSA blocking buffer to tube B1, PBS to tubes A2 and B2, and water to tubes A3 and B3.

steps.title: Load samples and antibodies onto slides
steps.instruction: Load up to ten samples and up to five antibodies into the slide wells following the column‑wise pattern: fill the first column of each slide downwards, the second column upwards, and the third column downwards. Load samples and antibodies in their respective tuberacks down the columns and then across the rows, matching the slide layout.

steps.title: Set protocol parameters
steps.instruction: In the Opentrons app, enter the exact number of samples and antibodies you are using and specify the mount side (left or right) for the P20 and P300 single‑GEN2 electronic pipettes.

steps.title: Obtain protocol files
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package supplied for this mass‑spec sample preparation.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, upload the custom 3‑grid 3 × 8 slide mount definition and any other custom labware files.

steps.title: Arrange deck according to map
steps.instruction: Place the slide mounts, tuberacks, 20 µL tip rack, and 300 µL tip rack on the deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the OT App to calibrate each piece of labware, the tip racks, and the P20 and P300 pipettes using the supplied calibration tips.

steps.title: Run the protocol
steps.instruction: Press ‘Run’ in the OT App to start the automated mass‑spec sample preparation.
